historicalWholeDevelopmentAndCaptureProj.basis: Rounded upward from an observed 78 / 12 percentage-point account decrease across the prior development and capture cycle.

observedAllowanceSamplesInThisChat.interpretation: These shared-account observations include prior preparation and supervision and may include other activity. They are not isolated consumption measurements for this run.

estimateBasis.remainingScope: One bounded run of at most nine frozen Gemini requests with zero retries, followed by outcome review and commit. The launcher, frozen inputs, namespace, and execution path are already prepared; no recapture or remedial implementation is projected.
estimateBasis.projectedExecutionOnlyCost: 50 five-hour and 15 weekly percentage points, estimated for the remaining execution, outcome review, and commit work.
estimateBasis.measurementStatus: Uncertain estimate; not measured Gemini-call consumption and not a guarantee of available shared Codex allowance.
estimateBasis.sharedAccountRisk: Other chats or account activity may consume shared allowance during this work; a fresh actual allowance sample remains required at the launch rendezvous and during execution and review.
